title: Control two-way RomM synchronization
description: Filter automatic publishing by verification evidence, console, region, category, and import. Opt into inbound discovery on selected RomM platforms, exact-content duplicate prevention, scheduled metadata refresh, and confirmed conflict handling.
upgrade: Back up application data, managed storage, and the RomM database/library before upgrading. Inbound imports and scheduled metadata refresh default to off. Save platform selections and try a small backed-up library before enabling broader automation. New imports require complete per-file SHA-1 hashes and sizes from RomM and remain unchecked.
limitations: Publishing requires a shared export library. Synchronization never automatically overwrites or deletes conflicting files. Live RomM compatibility testing remains outstanding; coverage uses a local protocol fixture.
